thought.text: The config directory doesn't exist yet (the guide omits `mkdir -p`, which the Taskfile does). Let me fix that:

reasoning_content:
The `openssl rsa -traditional` step failed. Let me check what happened. The first part (genpkey) succeeded — I can see the progress output. The issue is probably with `openssl rsa -traditional`. Let me check if the file was created.

Wait, "An error occurred during execution" — the exit code was 1. Let me investigate. Maybe the directory `/workspace/deploy/compose/config/` doesn't exist. Earlier I ran `ls /workspace/deploy/compose/config/` and got the error "No such file or directory". The taskfile's `gen:private-key:local` task runs `mkdir -p $(dirname ...)` first. The manual steps in the guide don't include mkdir. Let me create the directory first and then retry.

action.command: mkdir -p /workspace/deploy/compose/config && cd /workspace/deploy/compose/example/local && openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -outform PEM -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:4096 2>/dev/null | openssl rsa -traditional -out ../../config/token_service_key.pem && chmod 644 ../../config/token_service_key.pem && ls -la ../../config/ && head -1 ../../config/token_service_key.pem
